steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each category is placed by its change on last week and whether it is categorised.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Category up 27 percent with no note
findings.fix: Explain the rise and name the cause

findings.title: Recurring cause not recorded
findings.fix: Record the cause of the recurring ticket

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] cat-access:12  Category up 27 percent with no note.
       Fix: Explain the rise and name the cause.
[medium] cat-uncategorised:19  Tickets with no category.
       Fix: Categorise the tickets.
[low] cat-network:26  Recurring cause not recorded.
       Fix: Record the cause of the recurring ticket.
Not checked: The cause of recurring tickets.
pros: Flags a category up more than 25 percent with no note, and a ticket with no category.
cons: Not checked: The cause of recurring tickets.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-techops-ticket-trend skill on the records for this review.
